description: NaLi₂PO₄ is Aluminum carbonitride-derived structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.82 Å. Li is bonded to four O atoms to form LiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent LiO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 1.98-2.02 Å. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with eight equivalent LiO₄ tetrahedra. All P-O bond lengths are 1.56 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Li, and one P atom to form distorted ONa₂Li₂P trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₂Li₂P trigonal bipyramids, corners with six equivalent ONaLi₂P trigonal pyramids, and edges with two equivalent ONaLi₂P trigonal pyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded to one Na, two equivalent Li, and one P atom to form distorted ONaLi₂P trigonal pyramids that share corners with three equivalent ONa₂Li₂P trigonal bipyramids, corners with four equivalent ONaLi₂P trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₂Li₂P trigonal bipyramid. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Li, and one P atom.
